sources.title: An AI-IoT Based Smart Wheelchair with Gesture-Controlled Mobility, Deep ...
sources.snippet: This paper presented an affordable AI-IoT smart wheelchair integrating gesture control, real-time navigation assistance, and continuous health monitoring. The system enables hands-free operation through natural movements, with safety features including ultrasonic obstacle detection, YOLOv8-based computer vision, and auditory feedback.

sources.title: GitHub - TeamAMPTY/Smart-Wheelchair
sources.snippet: SMIFTY is a smart wheelchair designed to enhance user mobility, safety, and convenience through the integration of computer vision and advanced safety features. This project leverages YOLO-based object detection for navigating the wheelchair, ensuring obstacle avoidance and promoting a secure user experience.

sources.title: Smart Wheelchairs: Features to Look for in 2025
sources.snippet: Smart wheelchairs offer seniors far more than mobility—they provide a foundation for independence, safety, and comfort. Features like obstacle detection, health monitoring, adaptive controls, long-lasting batteries, and ergonomic seating deliver a comprehensive support system tailored to individual needs.
